name: Manifold Dual Marching Cubes
definition: Precomputes a lookup table to resolve ambiguous configurations in Dual Marching Cubes by mapping each problematic cube configuration (0-255) to its ambiguous face direction, or 255 if non-problematic.
summary: Manifold Dual Marching Cubes is a surface extraction algorithm that resolves ambiguous configurations in standard Dual Marching Cubes to guarantee a watertight, manifold mesh.
